mapper.select: SELECT position_id, account_id, trading_mode, stock_code, quantity, avg_price, stop_loss_price, take_profit_price FROM trading_position WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND trading_mode = #{tradingMode} AND quantity > 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY stock_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_position (account_id, trading_mode, stock_code, quantity, avg_price) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tradingMode}, #{stockCode}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = VALUES(quantity), avg_price = VALUES(avg_price), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
